1251-2105-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1251-2105-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-2105-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

339-677-6633-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-6633-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2586-5231-7690--165.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat

4613-4667-4687.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Elvish Aberration has a +1/+1 counter on it.

2060-2946-3899-6701.notablePrerequisites: You've had a non-Skeleton creature die under your control this turn.
2060-2946-3899-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2946-3899-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

5751-6462-6495-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.
5751-6462-6495-7104-7105.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

5572-6249-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5572-6249-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7154.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

628-3108-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.
628-3108-8095.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

2783-4247-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

851-4365-6664-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3129-4772-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
3129-4772-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

223-5938.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus the cost of the additional sorcery
223-5938.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional castable sorcery.
223-5938.description:
Cast any sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Flare of Duplication by paying its mana cost or by sacrificing a nontoken red creature other than Kalamax.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Flare of Duplication and choosing to copy the original Flare of Duplication.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Flare of Duplication copy, creating a copy of Flare of Duplication.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.

560-2034-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-2034-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4478-4772.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2713-3094-4659-5223-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-4659-5223-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

141-3497-7101.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
141-3497-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-2921-4147-4294.easyPrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-2921-4147-4294.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R} and paying any commander tax if relevant.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Etali.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from Step 3.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5921-5970-6965-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1322-2366-3688-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1322-2366-3688-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-1086-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1086-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

465-719-3742-4251-6968.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1497-2173-5220-5933.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature with base power 7 or greater

1692-3398-6870.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger or Fire Lord Ozai
1692-3398-6870.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of the creature it is attached to.
Declare Hellkite Charger and Fire Lord Ozai as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Fire Lord Ozai trigger, causing you to sacrifice the token made in step 1 and add an amount of {R} equal to the token's power.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-5141.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker, triggering its ability, copying Teferi's Protection and causing you to pay {2}{W} to cast the copy from exile.
Resolve the Teferi's Protection copy, causing your life total to be unable to change until your next turn and causing all permanents you control to phase out.
Repeat during each of your turns.

745-3372-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirrorhall Mimic
745-3372-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Mirrorhall Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mirrorhall Mimic's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Mirrorhall Mimic's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Mirrorhall Mimic's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

488-874-2895-3200-4986.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of either Delif's Cone or Urza's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-874-2895-3200-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1077-5147-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
1077-5147-5434-5555.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4094-4365-5794.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2457-4094-4365-5794.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2438-5572.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2438-5572.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2871-3009-4445.notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to a legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
2871-3009-4445.description:
Activate the creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {4}{R} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, targeting Akroan Conscriptor.
Akroan Conscriptor triggers, causing you to untap the creature with Leyline Immersion attached.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving Akroan Conscriptor +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target another creature with Seething Anger to get infinitely powerful creatures until end of turn, or you may use Akroan Conscriptor's ability to untap any other creature(s) you control.

301-687-1242-2034.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Putrid Goblin dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a -1/-1 counter from Cinderhaze Wretch, and both counters from Putrid Goblin.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 3-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Putrid Goblin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
